theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: Compounding: Your Money's Best Friend Over Time
body: Regular investments harness compounding's power. Time multiplies your efforts exponentially through disciplined, consistent contributions.
caption: Investing fixed amounts regularly helps you buy more units when prices dip and fewer when they rise. This approach smooths out market volatility over your investment journey. #CompoundingPower #RupeeCostAveraging #InvestmentBasics #WealthBuilding #TimeinMarket
